title: Default Effect
coreMove: Name the default effect effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame Default Effect as a specific decision error around default effect, opt-in, organ donation. Traceable support includes Do Defaults Save Lives?.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Default Effect as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: name the default effect effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.

hook: Do not open with a definition of Default Effect.
Do not use a generic panic-at-a-meeting opener.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable shape where the obvious answer is wrong and the opposite is true.
Do not make Default Effect sound like ordinary carelessness.
examples: No coffee mug, classroom whiteboard, bus depot, radiator, bike helmet, or narrow kitchen shell.
